closes: Extends constant-crosscheck-v1's Check-2 density second-source discipline to the 4 load-bearing hardener density facts (ancamide_2353/260a/350a, versamid_115) that had ZERO independent coverage in any of the module's four prior signed receipts, with no stated exclusion reason (unlike the pigment-density exclusion, which IS documented).

Independently verifies, against a document the catalog does not itself cite, that the catalog's own self-disclosed regional-conflict note for ancamide_260a.ahew ("US 120 vs EMEA 110") is empirically accurate rather than an unverified claim.
Re-derives amine_value and AHEW for ancamide_350a and ancamide_2353 as a byproduct, corroborating the amine-value<->AHEW admissibility band inputs used by amine-value-ahew-consistency-v1.
does_not_close: Three of five comparisons re-fetch the SAME url the catalog already cites -- a transcription/link-rot check, NOT a supplier-independent measured lock.

Does not resolve the versamid_115 brand-lineage risk the catalog's own note flags (Cognis -> BASF -> Huntsman/Gabriel); only shows the BASF-era value is within gate of the shipped value, not that a current Huntsman-era TDS agrees.
Gate is a point-transcription tolerance (3%), not a physical admissibility bound; does NOT establish product qualification or supplier closure.
headline: Closed an undisclosed gap: 4/13 load-bearing hardener density facts (plus 2 AHEW and 1 amine-value facts checked as byproducts) had ZERO independent coverage across the module's four prior signed receipts. External live manufacturer-TDS re-verification: 8/9 comparisons within the 3.0% gate (6 transcription-fidelity re-fetches of the catalog's own cited source, 3 genuinely independent second-source comparisons). The catalog's own self-disclosed ancamide_260a regional-conflict note (US 120 vs EMEA 110) verified EMPIRICALLY ACCURATE against live-refetched regional documents.
hypothesis: Every shipped load-bearing hardener density/AHEW/amine-value constant matches, within a 3% gate, the primary manufacturer literature it is drawn from (transcription fidelity + link-rot check), and, where a genuinely independent document exists (BASF Versamid 115 SDS; Ancamide 260A EMEA regional TDS), the catalog's own disclosed uncertainty notes are empirically accurate.
non_circularity: Three comparisons (350A x3 facts, 2353 x2 facts) re-fetch the SAME url already cited in facts.json -- disclosed as transcription/link-rot checks, not independent corroboration. Two comparisons (versamid_115 density vs BASF SDS; ancamide_260a AHEW vs the EMEA document) are against a document the catalog does NOT cite as its primary source for that fact -- genuine independent second-source checks.
purpose: External live manufacturer-TDS re-verification of load-bearing hardener density/AHEW/amine-value facts that none of the four prior signed audit receipts in this module ever checked (an undisclosed coverage gap in constant-crosscheck-v1's Check-2 density second-source discipline).
